name: gonkarouter_chat
description: Send multi-turn chat messages to a GonkaRouter AI model (DeepSeek, MiniMax, GLM, etc.)

model.description: Model ID to use (e.g. 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731', 'MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.7', 'zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash'). Defaults to deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
